description:
## Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add
Audit existing Agent/Engine/Ingestion Actions, APIs, workflow Steps and Oban status before implementation. Finalize generic job envelope (allowlisted processor key plus processor-owned request data), status owner, provider-error versus crash retry policy, input/category/model budgets, typed errors, preflight timeout/probe, unattended reporting, actor context and migration handling for legacy queued jobs. Resolve newly enabled targets using the agreed no-silent-backfill principle; escalate any new product choice. Distinguish initial classification, retained stale results and pending replacement attempts. Record concrete module/docs ownership and candidate rejection evidence for every downstream operation. This is a blocking contract task, not permission to invent fallback behavior.
Owners/files: Repo source and docs/service owners; task notes only unless canonical documentation needs clarification.

## Tests to add before implementation
Inspect existing tests; define contract/property/negative-identity scenarios before consumers. Verify no duplicate classifier or ingestion retry path. No application changes required for audit.
Preserve existing expectations unless explicitly approved; property-test invariants where applicable.

## Branches/paths validated
Cover success, denied/nil actor, absent configuration/resource, stale/concurrent state, invalid input and side-effect failure as relevant to the operation above. Record concrete assertions before coding. Honor the agreed terminal provider-failure versus infrastructure-recovery distinction.

## Mocking plan
Mock only external provider HTTP/conversion/embedding edges where applicable; keep Repo/Sandbox, Oban, NodeRouter, Jido validation and ZAQ domains real. Resolve runtime dependencies through Zaq.Config.get/4 and explicit opts/context. Deterministic barriers/clock/ID controls; no global Application environment mutation or cross-test PubSub leakage. Audit-only tasks need no mocks.

## Documentations to update for both code and docs/
Update changed module contracts and applicable owning Agent/Ingestion/System/architecture/BO guides; no duplicate standards. Tests/gate-only work records evidence in this issue. Read DESIGN.md/BO component guide for UI, relevant service guide before domain changes.

## Action reuse assessment
Local-only planning audit; prior verified candidates include ProviderSpec.operation_runtime/1 (assumes sampling fields), RAGModelConfig, Agent.Tools.Registry, General.EncodeJson workflow Action, TranslateKnowledgeQuery provider validation, Ingestion.Api, Labels.ResourceLabels and Ingestion retry_job/1 (re-ingests, not classification-only). Recheck signatures and @moduledoc; inspect newly proposed reclassification/preflight operation candidates before approving contracts.
Before implementation recheck candidate @moduledoc, schemas, callers and tests, record concrete evidence and final public input/output/error/permission/retry contracts. Missing standalone Actions must be implemented in their prerequisite issue before callers. Nil identity never grants authority; cross-role BO operations use fixed Events and NodeRouter. No generic invoke endpoint.

## Scope, prerequisites and validation
Parent PR2 epic: zaq-kw0.42; reviewed source: https://chatgpt.com/space/page_fa28a6b2fe70819199a0a178f96c7fb6 .
Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md and docs/action-reuse.md. Dependencies wired on creation; do not start before prerequisites complete.
Immediate scoped tests and mix q per issue; final mix precommit belongs to zaq-kw0.20 after review/coverage. Existing feature human UX gate zaq-kw0.15 -> consolidated E2E zaq-kw0.16 remains open in PR3; add scenarios now, author new feature E2E only after explicit approval. Existing required E2E execution remains applicable.
Planning only: no implementation, code commit/push/merge or approval granted by creating this issue.

comments.text: Execution audit: extend ProviderSpec with evaluation_runtime/1 using canonical operation_runtime authentication but no sampling options; RAGModelConfig lacks temperature/top_p, so normalize via Map.get preserving generation callers. Installed ReqLLM.Evaluation.evaluate/4 supports independent boolean questions and normalized Response.object, callable models via Evaluation.models/0; provider errors remain terminal and sanitized. New reusable Classify workflow/Jido Action owns bounded supplied text/categories validation and exact probability mapping, Registry entry and confidential Agent classify Event; no Ingestion lookup or threshold. Extend existing System get/save_rag_model_config for Decision-only 0..100 threshold default 80; retain Engine authorization. New local PostProcessing dispatcher/shared Oban worker owns status and allowlisted processor, typed IDs/generation/request data; use processor-owned durable reservations, retry infrastructure crashes only, terminal provider outcomes persisted. Budgets: 65536 UTF-8 text bytes, 32 categories, ID/name 200 bytes, description 4096 bytes, 15s total request timeout with max_retries 0; preflight fixed small boolean probe under same bound. Reservation captures threshold, definition version, generation and assignment version; final write compares all under locks; no model call while locked. Manual origins/exclusions/values always win. Extend existing Ingestion entry points and job payload/schema for immutable enabled/skipped run decision, propagate to children/retry; absent legacy decision defaults skipped without inference. Definition create never schedules; confirmed definition edits select only presently selected affected chunks authorized to actor, then all eligible automatic chunk labels; Not now retains assignments. Reuse Labels/ResourceLabels permissions and optimistic versions, Document/Chunk lifecycle and existing job/status surfaces; reject retry_job for reclassification because it reingests. New affected-chunk and Decision readiness Actions are tracked by existing .42.7/.42.5 prerequisites. No new product semantics or generic invoke endpoints. Negative-identity, stale-generation/manual race, malformed probabilities and threshold capture tests required before consumers; existing behavioral expectations remain unchanged unless separately approved. Audit-only validation: inspected source and installed dependency contracts, no application code changed; mix q/application tests not applicable.
